select b.* from business_card b,tb_user u where b.user_id = u.user_id and u.is_vip = 1
and b.card_status = #{businessCard.cardStatus}
and (b.industry_first_name like concat("%",#{businessCard.keyWord},"%") or b.industry_second_name like concat("%",#{businessCard.keyWord},"%") or b.company_name like concat("%",#{businessCard.keyWord},"%"))
and b.company_province like concat("%",#{businessCard.companyProvince},"%")
and b.company_city like concat("%",#{businessCard.companyCity},"%")
and b.company_district like concat("%",#{businessCard.companyDistrict},"%")
and b.industry_first_name like concat("%",#{businessCard.industryFirstName},"%")
and b.industry_second_name like concat("%",#{businessCard.industrySecondName},"%")
and company_flair REGEXP #{businessCard.companyFlair}
order by u.vip_end_time desc
order by b.create_time desc
SELECT company_province as city FROM `business_card` WHERE audit_status = 1 GROUP BY company_province
SELECT company_city as city FROM `business_card` WHERE audit_status = 1 and company_province = #{city} GROUP BY company_city
SELECT company_district as city FROM `business_card` WHERE audit_status = 1 and company_city = #{city} GROUP BY company_district

SELECT b.*, (select count(*) from user_card_list ucl where ucl.card_id=b.card_id and ucl.user_id=#{userId}) as userCardListCount FROM business_card b WHERE b.card_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT bc.* FROM business_card bc WHERE bc.card_phone like concat('%', #{phone} ,'%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_staff_record csr WHERE csr.staff_card_id = bc.card_id AND csr.card_id = #{cardId})

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dayStr, card_type as cardType, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM business_card WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND #{endDate} >= create_time GROUP BY dayStr, card_type ORDER BY dayStr ASC, card_type ASC
